fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
An alert when a count crosses your line

Set a line, such as half the buyers of one style saying it runs small. The merchandiser gets a Slack or email alert once it is crossed, naming the style and the count.
fieldData.alpb---prompt: Build clothes survey questions for my denim brand that ask each buyer how the jean fits in the waist, hip, and length.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A phone vote on the fall sweater color shows rust leading with 88 of 205 votes, ahead of oat at 51, and rust gets the larger mill order.
